name: Hemolytic Anemia Due to Hexose Monophosphate Shunt and Glutathione Metabolism Anomalies

diagnosticCriteria.formalCriteriaName: WHO Criteria for G6PD Deficiency Diagnosis

criteria.description: Reduced glucose-6-phosphate dehydrogenase enzyme activity in erythrocytes
Presence of acute or chronic hemolytic anemia episodes triggered by oxidative stress
Identification of pathogenic variants in G6PD gene or related glutathione metabolism genes
Elevated reticulocyte count during hemolytic episodes
Episodes of dark urine consistent with hemoglobinuria during hemolysis

diagnosticCriteria.minimumForDiagnosis: Reduced enzyme activity plus clinical evidence of hemolytic anemia; genetic confirmation supportive but not mandatory
diagnosticCriteria.notes: Diagnosis is often clinical supported by enzyme assay; genetic testing aids in confirmation and family counseling
